---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for Sylou.
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

<!--
Thanks for taking the time to suggest a feature. The most useful feature
requests focus on the *problem* or *use case* rather than a specific
implementation: that gives the maintainer and community room to think
about the best way to solve it.

If you're already proposing a specific implementation, that's fine too;
just please also describe the problem it solves.
-->

## The use case

<!--
What are you trying to do? Who would benefit from this feature? In what
situation does the current behavior fall short?
-->

## What you'd like to be able to do

<!-- A description of the feature or capability you're proposing. -->

## Why this matters

<!--
What value would this add to Sylou? Is it about transparency, usability,
accessibility, integration with another tool, a methodology improvement,
something else?
-->

## Possible approach *(optional)*

<!--
If you have a specific implementation idea, describe it here. Otherwise,
leave this section blank; the maintainer and community can discuss
approaches once the use case is understood.
-->

## Alternatives you've considered *(optional)*

<!-- Other ways you've thought about solving this, and why they fall short. -->

## Additional context

<!-- Anything else — examples from other tools, links, screenshots, related issues. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to confirm this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have described the use case, not just the implementation
- [ ] I understand that feature requests are evaluated against the project's direction and the maintainer's available time (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#a-note-on-pace-and-continuity))
